arguments.command:
set -eu
LOG=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/ollama-runtime.log
echo '--- OCT2 EVENT WINDOW 07:00-10:30 LOCAL ---'
awk '
/2026-10-02T(0[7-9]|10):/ || /\[GIN\] 2026\/10\/02 - (0[7-9]|10):/ {
  if (tolower($0) ~ /(load|runner|memory|model|sched|generate|chat|completion|post|unload|evict)/) print
}' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 240
echo '--- NEARBY MODEL LOAD LINES OCT2 ---'
grep '2026-10-02' "$LOG" 2>/dev/null | grep -E -i 'loading model|load request|runner|offload|memory|unload|expired|evict|model=' | head -n 240 || true
